review.reason: The current stable official Google ai-edge-litert 2.2.0 wheel family is the smallest cross-platform LiteRT Python runtime candidate found for the repository's Windows/Linux CPU target, but its exact v2.2.0 package metadata requires backports.strenum unconditionally while the latest backports.strenum 1.3.1 distribution declares Python >=3.8.6,<3.11 and explicitly does not install on Python >=3.11. Analytics-lab's Linux and Windows quality jobs are both pinned to Python 3.11. Normal dependency resolution therefore cannot satisfy the reviewed runtime package in the existing bounded evidence lane. Installing with --no-deps, changing the whole repository Python baseline, or suppressing the declared dependency would weaken the dependency gate, so this exact path is stopped before installation or execution.

native_and_redistribution_review.reason_for_early_stop: The mandatory Python dependency graph is already unsatisfiable on the repository's required Python 3.11 Linux/Windows lane, so resolving every remaining transitive package or bundled native notice cannot make this exact package installable without changing or bypassing the declared dependency contract.

closure.next_smallest_testable_direction: Continue the already-selected distinct TensorFlow CPU 2.21.0 fallback review against exact source tag v2.21.0 / commit a481b10260dfdf833a1b16007eead49c1d7febf3. It publishes CPython 3.11 Windows and Linux CPU wheels and the exact source retains tf.compat.v1.lite.TFLiteConverter.from_frozen_graph, so it can consume the admitted frozen GraphDef without repeating the closed OpenCV or legacy TensorFlow 1.15/Bazel paths. Before any install or execution, pin its exact selected wheels, dependency resolution, native components, licenses and redistribution notices. Do not use the TensorFlow 2.22.0rc0 prerelease released 2026-09-22 as a substitute for the current stable 2.21.0 path.
